gen-gf-revalia-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab has a dignified serif voice, its c gaping wide and its rounded lowercase standing tall. Epunda Slab against Revalia's bold, widely spaced display letters makes the loudest thing about this pair its sheer difference in temperament.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-glegoo: Glegoo brings a refined, editorial serif with big counters and wide-mouthed curves. And Revalia, with its open-tailed g and loose stride, earns its place when the words are big and few.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-hanuman: Revalia swaggers in with a bold, expressive stride and an open-bottomed g, while Hanuman follows in a traditional, high-waisted serif. Their two voices share the page without crowding.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noticia-text: Loud on top, literary below. Noticia Text opens each curved letter with a visible entrance and fills its lines with tall lowercase bodies, so Revalia's bold display voice hands over to something dignified and steady.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla is a refined, authoritative classic serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals. But Revalia, bold and widely spaced above it, gives the page a loud opening line before that quiet authority takes over.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-pridi: Pridi's small letters stand nearly capital-sized. What stands out most is the clash of Revalia's bold, expressive display swagger with that refined, classic serif, which leaves generous space between curve ends and stems.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-scope-one: Big, loose, a bit theatrical. Revalia is best at bold, widely spaced display lines, and Scope One is best at the traditional text serif work of spilling its counters into the space around its big x-height.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px is a bookish, dignified serif with large open counters in its tall a, e and s. And Revalia's bold, expressive display letters sit above it, stretching out with that relaxed, widely spaced stride.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum has a dignified, editorial classic serif look, with a c as open as a bent paperclip and a high x-height. But Revalia does its best work with bold, expressive display lines, leaving the body font to carry the steady text.
